author: bounded implementer (non-product validation tooling; records no human decision)
scope: Primary-ownership index for register items A-01..A-13. Acceptance reflects the genuine current recorded state of each artifact and is not a status mirror of the v2 register. Rows whose evidence is genuinely complete and digest-bound are ACCEPTED; A-09 is accepted only via a recorded product-owner private-gate waiver (no competent trademark assessment) and says so honestly; A-07, A-12, and A-13 remain INCOMPLETE pending the outstanding product-owner ceiling/capacity/target decisions and are never faked as ACCEPTED.

acceptance_vocabulary.ACCEPTED: The row's evidence is complete and carries its required current human decision and digest.
acceptance_vocabulary.PENDING: The artifact exists but a required human decision or acceptance is still open.
acceptance_vocabulary.INCOMPLETE: A required artifact for this row has not been produced yet.

acceptance_basis_note: A row may carry an optional acceptance_basis field. PRIVATE_GATE_WAIVER_NOT_COMPETENT_ASSESSMENT (A-09) means the row is accepted for the private Phase 0A gate on a recorded product-owner non-legal basis, not on a competent trademark/legal assessment; formal clearance stays deferred and required before any public/commercial launch.
digest_convention: Per-record digests use sha256 of compact sorted UTF-8 JSON excluding the digest field (see a-01 and source-package-inventory conventions). Manifest artifact digest fields carry the value recorded inside each artifact, or null while pending; the validator does not treat a null digest as acceptance.
ownership_note: The register_item set must equal A-01..A-13 exactly once with no duplicate primary owner.
